entries.title: Adding a Claude account no longer stops at a login Claude Code left empty
entries.body: When Claude Code had signed out or its login had lapsed, adding a Claude account could refuse every time, saying Infinitary couldn't read the Claude login. It now goes on to Claude's own sign-in. A Claude account already added in that state now shows as signed out with a Sign in button, instead of a login that couldn't be read. If the login really can't be read, the advice on Windows now points to the Start menu instead of the Dock, and the message is in your language.
entries.noPicture: The change is in how Claude Code's login file is read; it shows only when that file holds no login, which could not be set up and photographed on this Mac.
